messages:
deploy-bot: Initiated staged rollout: nlp-inference v0.8.0-beta -> 7% traffic in ap-south-1. change-window 2026-03-25 03:00-04:00 UTC. notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/nlp-inference/0.8.0-beta

emily: quick eyeball on SLOs — p95 creeping up to ~600ms from baseline 180ms, small but consistent 429s showing up. p99 still noisy.

jared: looking at traces: a bunch of requests queueing at the batching layer, batch sizes spiking because the new dynamic-batcher groups larger sequences. Might be starvation under bursty traffic.

infra-bot: Alert: nlp-inference ap-south-1 rate-limited responses > threshold (policy=NL-BATCH). Recommend manual hold.

anna: can we reduce rollout and pin staged cohort back to v0.7.12 while we patch? prefer to avoid messing with global routing.

emily: agree. pin first then triage. jared, can you run the pin?

jared: executing pin: ```/release pause service=nlp-inference cohort=staged version=v0.7.12 reason="batching queue overflow / 429s"```

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 7%. Cohort pinned to v0.7.12 for staged traffic. action_id=rl-4960001234-pause

ops-bot: Routing change applied. 7% cohort now served by v0.7.12. Telemetry backfill ~50s.

emily: after pin p95 back to ~190ms, 429s dropping to baseline. Good sign.

jared: will take trace and batching metrics triage. Initial hypothesis: dynamic-batcher miscalculates latency budget leading to oversized groups. If confirmed I'll revert the grouping heuristic and roll a hotfix v0.8.0-rc1.

anna: please add a short note to release page that we paused the staged rollout and the reason: https://redwood.internal/releases/nlp-inference/0.8.0-beta/notes (editing)

oncall: monitoring the change-window and standing by to escalate. If any region shows similar signals, we will abort the broader rollout.

jared: estimate 25-40m to validate and prepare a patch. If the patch is fast, propose a 0.5% micro-probe behind the feature flag before resuming 7%.

emily: sounds good. Also add a temporary throttle recommendation in the ops runbook to limit batch size until fix is live.

infra-bot: created incident tag INC-4960001234 for post-check triage tracking.

anna: thanks all. keeping thread open for findings and then we'll decide go/no-go for re-run. :white_check_mark:
